comments.author: WW
comments.body:
Do you need to have casting to make this?

After the search effect it has the number 10. Does that mean it will increase search by 10 ranks when using the effect?

Thanks :)

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Private farms allow you to produce items even without the skill listed (in this case, Casting). All that matters is that you have the required materials for production, and that your farm meets the minimum requirements for a recipe to appear, which in this case requires a technology degree of 100, and two facilities.

Source: gvo.gamedb.info/wiki/?Privatefarm

I suppose the number ten does indeed mean R10 Search when the item's used, but given its low durability, and the fact that I seem to recall you never get skill proficiency points when you use an item effect instead of the actual skill, I've never really tested that out for myself.
